metadata.case_name: NG SHING KWAI v. CHAN YU CHUEN T/A SHEUNG MOON CIVIL ENGINEERING CO. AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Moderate to advanced degenerative changes of the back at L4 and facet joints of L5-S1, i.e. the lumbar spine.
source: 2) Moderate to advanced degenerative changes of the back at L4 and facet joints of L5-S1, i.e. the lumbar spine.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: Contusion of the right shoulder muscle with residual inflammation of the muscle.
source: Diagnosis was multiple contusions of the right shoulder, elbow and back with bruising.

Dr Tsoi found that the contusion of the shoulder muscle with residual inflammation of the muscle accounted for 5 per cent impairment of the right upper limb or 3 per cent permanent impairment of the whole person.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia or tendon at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: Advanced osteoarthritic changes at the right elbow, exacerbated by the accident.
source: 1) Advanced osteoarthritic changes at the right elbow.

I find that the accident had caused the shoulder impairment, aggravated the plaintiff's hitherto asymptomatic but degenerative spine and exacerbated the right elbow condition, the AMA guide produced by defence counsel notwithstanding.
